parameters.content:
## Setup before running
Attach a GitHub credential with Actions: write for blue45f/toonspectrum to the HTTP Request node. No credentials are embedded. Merge creator-brand-film.yml first. Choose all / landscape / portrait / square.

The result is only an accepted render request, not a completed video or publication. Inspect the run and review artifacts. No webhook, automatic social posting, shell execution, or main-branch writes are configured. Do not re-run a pending request: workflow dispatch is not idempotent.
